scanNote:
7-UNITNING UChINChI BETI (50-bet).

Yuqorida chapda KO'K yorliqda oq '7' va 'Profiles'.

CHAP USTUN:
• Pushti nuqta va to'q sariq 'Communication: Talking about Illnesses'.
9) Kasseta belgisi: 'Listen and repeat. Then, in pairs, use the prompts to act out similar dialogues.'
   A: What's the matter, Steve? B: I've got A HEADACHE. (tagi chizilgan) A: Why don't you TAKE AN ASPIRIN, then? (tagi chizilgan)
   Nuqtali ko'rsatmalar: • toothache - see the dentist • a stomach ache - stop eating chocolates • a cough - take some cough medicine • the flu - go to bed
• OCh KO'K quti, oq katta harflar 'Just · Already · Yet': • 'We use ALREADY or JUST in positive statements.' To'q sariq qiya: "I've ALREADY booked my flight." / "I've JUST broken the vase." • 'We use YET in questions and negations.' 'Have you done the shopping YET?' / "She hasn't phoned her mother YET."
10) 'Read Danny's list of chores and look at the picture, then tick (✓) what he has already done and put a cross (✗) against what he hasn't done yet. Finally, make sentences as in the example.'
   SURAT (chizma): Dannyning xonasi - javonlarda kitoblar tartibli terilgan, devorda U2 plakati va rasm, deraza toza (bulutlar ko'rinadi), karavot ko'k choyshab bilan tartibli yig'ilgan, tumbochka ustida radio va piyola, POLDA kurtka va chiroq ag'darilgan, poldа qog'ozlar sochilgan.
   Katakchali ro'yxat: make bed, clean window, put books on shelves | hang clothes in wardrobe, remove dirty cups, pick papers up off floor
   Ko'k qiya namuna: 'He has ALREADY made his bed.'

O'NG USTUN:
11) 'Complete the sentences about what you have or haven't done today.' To'rt qator: I've already ......... . / I ......... yet. / I ......... today. / I've just ......... .
12) Kasseta belgisi: 'Listen to the noises and number the events in the order you hear them. Then, use the prompts to make sentences about what has JUST happened in each picture.'
   OLTI SURAT (A-F, katakchali): A - erkak ko'prikdan suvga tushib ketmoqda (he/fall/in the water); B - samolyot ko'tarilmoqda (plane/take off); C - bola to'p bilan derazani sindirgan (he/break/window); D - ishchi bolg'a bilan barmog'ini urib olgan (he/hit/finger); E - ayol vazani tushirib yuborgan, vaza singan (she/drop/vase); F - qizil mashina parkovka hisoblagichiga urilgan (car/crash/into the parking meter).
13) Kasseta belgisi: 'Joanne and her husband have recently moved into a new house. Listen and tick (✓) what they've done so far.' Katakchali ro'yxat: paint the walls, hang the curtains, lay the carpets, repair the back door | buy all the furniture, put up shelves, tidy the garden, mend the fence. Ostida qalin: 'Now make sentences about what they've already done, and what they haven't done yet.'
• Pushti nuqta va to'q sariq 'Writing (Project)': 'Look at the Photo File section and complete the letter Joanne sent to her friend.'

Bet raqami: pastda chapda '50'.

exercises.explanationUz:
KASALLIK HAQIDA DIALOG.


⚠ "WHAT'S THE MATTER?":

  = Nima bo'ldi? Tinchlikmi?
  ⚠ "What's wrong?" bilan bir xil.
  ⚠ 'the matter' bu yerda = muammo.


⚠ "I'VE GOT A HEADACHE":

  = Boshim og'riyapti.
  ⚠ Britaniyada 'have got',
  AQShda 'have'.
  ⚠ 'a headache' - 'A' bilan
  (sanaladigan).


⚠ "WHY DON'T YOU ...?":

  = ... qilsangiz-chi? (MASLAHAT)
  ⚠ Savol shaklida, lekin ma'nosi
  taklif.
  ⚠ 'Why don't you' + fe'l (to SIZ).


⚠ 'TO TAKE AN ASPIRIN':

  = aspirin ichmoq.
  ⚠ Dori uchun 'TAKE' - 'drink'
  yoki 'eat' EMAS!
  ⚠ 'take medicine' = dori ichmoq.

sentences.en: A: Why don't you take an aspirin, then?

exercises.instructionEn: Then, in pairs, use the prompts to act out similar dialogues.
exercises.instructionUz: So'ng juftlikda ko'rsatmalardan foydalanib shunga o'xshash dialoglar tuzing.
exercises.explanationUz:
TO'RT KO'RSATMA:

  toothache - see the dentist
  a stomach ache - stop eating
     chocolates
  a cough - take some cough medicine
  the flu - go to bed


⚠ QOLIP:

  A: What's the matter, [ism]?
  B: I've got [kasallik].
  A: Why don't you [maslahat], then?


⚠ ARTIKLLAR:

  I've got A headache
  I've got toothache (artiklsiz)
  I've got A stomach ache
  I've got A cough
  I've got THE flu

  ⚠ Har kasallikning O'Z artikli bor -
  yodlash kerak.


⚠ 'A COUGH':

  = yo'tal.
  ⚠ O'qilishi /kɒf/ - 'kof'!
  ⚠ 'cough medicine' = yo'tal dorisi.


⚠ 'TO SEE THE DENTIST':

  = tish shifokoriga bormoq.
  ⚠ 'see a doctor' = shifokorga
  ko'rinmoq.


⚠ 'STOP' + -ING:

  'stop eatING chocolates'.

⚠ 'toothache' - ARTIKLSIZ.
⚠ 'see the dentist' = tish shifokoriga bormoq.

exercises.explanationUz:
PRESENT PERFECT BILAN UCh SO'Z.


╔══════════════════════════════════╗
║  ALREADY = allaqachon            ║
╚══════════════════════════════════╝

  TASDIQ gapda, 'have' va 3-shakl
  ORASIDA:
  "I've ALREADY booked my flight."


╔══════════════════════════════════╗
║  JUST = hozirgina                 ║
╚══════════════════════════════════╝

  TASDIQ gapda, 'have' va 3-shakl
  ORASIDA:
  "I've JUST broken the vase."


╔══════════════════════════════════╗
║  YET = hali                      ║
╚══════════════════════════════════╝

  SAVOL va INKORda, gap OXIRIDA:
  'Have you done the shopping YET?'
  "She hasn't phoned her mother YET."


⚠ O'RNI - ENG MUHIM:

  already/just → O'RTADA
     (have ___ done)
  yet → OXIRIDA
     (... done ___?)

  ⚠ "I've done it already" ham
  mumkin, lekin o'rtada odatiy.


⚠ 'YET' - TASDIQDA IShLATILMAYDI:

  ✗ "I've done it yet."
  ✓ "I've already done it."


⚠ 'TO BOOK A FLIGHT':

  = reysga chipta bron qilmoq.
  ⚠ 'to book' = bron qilmoq.


⚠ 'A VASE':

  = vaza (gul uchun).
  ⚠ Britaniyada /vɑːz/,
  AQShda /veɪs/.

points.en: We use already or just in positive statements.

points.uz: Men allaqachon reysga chipta bron qilganman.

points.en: We use yet in questions and negations.
points.uz: 'yet' ni savol va inkor gaplarda ishlatamiz.

points.en: Have you done the shopping yet? / She hasn't phoned her mother yet.
points.uz: Xaridni qilib bo'ldingmi hali? / U onasiga hali qo'ng'iroq qilmagan.

exercises.instructionEn: Read Danny's list of chores and look at the picture, then tick (✓) what he has already done and put a cross (✗) against what he hasn't done yet.
exercises.instructionUz: Dannyning yumushlar ro'yxatini o'qing va suratga qarang, so'ng allaqachon qilganlariga ✓, hali qilmaganlariga ✗ qo'ying.
exercises.explanationUz:
SURATDAN JAVOB.

  ✓ make bed - karavot yig'ilgan
  ✓ clean window - deraza toza
  ✓ put books on shelves - kitoblar
    javonda tartibli
  ✗ hang clothes in wardrobe - kurtka
    POLDA
  ✗ remove dirty cups - tumbochkada
    piyola turibdi
  ✗ pick papers up off floor -
    qog'ozlar POLDA


⚠ 'CHORES':

  = uy yumushlari.
  ⚠ O'qilishi /tʃɔːz/.


⚠ 'TO HANG':

  = osmoq.
  ⚠ hang - hung - hung (kiyim).


⚠ 'A WARDROBE':

  = kiyim shkafi.
  ⚠ O'qilishi /ˈwɔːdrəʊb/.


⚠ 'TO PICK UP':

  = yerdan olmoq, ko'tarmoq.
  ⚠ 'pick papers UP OFF the floor'.

items.whyUz:
⚠ Suratda karavot ko'k choyshab bilan tartibli
yig'ilgan.

exercises.instructionEn: Finally, make sentences as in the example.
exercises.explanationUz:
KITOBDAGI NAMUNA:
  'He has ALREADY made his bed.'


⚠ QOLIPLAR:

  ✓ → He has ALREADY + 3-shakl ...
  ✗ → He HASN'T + 3-shakl ... YET.


⚠ 3-ShAKLLAR:

  make → MADE
  clean → CLEANED
  put → PUT
  hang → HUNG
  remove → REMOVED
  pick up → PICKED UP


⚠ 'HIS' - EGALIK:

  'made HIS bed', 'HIS clothes' -
  ro'yxatda 'bed', 'clothes' lekin
  gapda egalik olmoshi kerak.
exercises.exampleEn: He has already made his bed.
modelAnswers: He has already made his bed.
He has already cleaned the window.
He has already put his books on the shelves.
He hasn't hung his clothes in the wardrobe yet.
He hasn't removed the dirty cups yet.
He hasn't picked the papers up off the floor yet.
modelAnswersUz: U hali iflos piyolalarni olib chiqmagan.

exercises.instructionEn: Complete the sentences about what you have or haven't done today.
exercises.instructionUz: Bugun nima qilganingiz yoki qilmaganingiz haqidagi gaplarni tugallang.
exercises.explanationUz:
TO'RT QOLIP - O'ZINGIZ HAQINGIZDA:

  I've already ......... .
  I ......... yet.
  I ......... today.
  I've just ......... .


⚠ 2-QATOR - INKOR:

  'I ... yet' → "I HAVEN'T ... yet"
  ⚠ 'yet' faqat inkor/savolda!


⚠ 3-QATOR - 'TODAY':

  'today' hali tugamagan davr →
  PRESENT PERFECT:
  "I've had lunch today."
  ⚠ Kun tugagan bo'lsa (kechqurun)
  past simple ham mumkin.
modelAnswers: I haven't done my homework yet.
I've spoken to my friend today.

exercises.instructionEn: Listen to the noises and number the events in the order you hear them. Then, use the prompts to make sentences about what has just happened in each picture.
exercises.instructionUz: Tovushlarni tinglang va voqealarni eshitgan tartibingizda raqamlang. So'ng ko'rsatmalardan foydalanib har suratda hozirgina nima bo'lganini ayting.
exercises.explanationUz:
⚠ RAQAMLASh uchun AUDIO KERAK.
  Gaplar esa suratdan tuziladi.


OLTI SURAT:

  A he/fall/in the water
    → He has just fallen in the
      water.
  B plane/take off
    → The plane has just taken off.
  C he/break/window
    → He has just broken the window.
  D he/hit/finger
    → He has just hit his finger.
  E she/drop/vase
    → She has just dropped the vase.
  F car/crash/into the parking meter
    → The car has just crashed into
      the parking meter.


⚠ 3-ShAKLLAR:

  fall - fell - FALLEN
  take - took - TAKEN
  break - broke - BROKEN
  hit - hit - HIT
  drop - dropped - DROPPED
  crash - crashed - CRASHED


⚠ 'TO TAKE OFF':

  = ko'tarilmoq (samolyot).
  ⚠ Aksi: 'to land' = qo'nmoq.


⚠ 'TO DROP':

  = tushirib yubormoq.
  ⚠ 'dropped' - 'p' IKKILANADI.


⚠ 'TO CRASH INTO':

  = ... ga urilmoq.
  ⚠ 'into' predlogi.


⚠ 'A PARKING METER':

  = to'xtash joyi hisoblagichi (pul
  tashlanadigan ustun).
exercises.exampleEn: He has just fallen in the water.
modelAnswers: He has just fallen in the water.
The plane has just taken off.
He has just broken the window.
He has just hit his finger.
She has just dropped the vase.
The car has just crashed into the parking meter.

exercises.instructionEn: Joanne and her husband have recently moved into a new house. Listen and tick (✓) what they've done so far. Now make sentences about what they've already done, and what they haven't done yet.
exercises.instructionUz: Joanne va eri yaqinda yangi uyga ko'chib o'tishdi. Tinglang va hozirgacha nima qilganlarini belgilang (✓). Endi allaqachon qilganlari va hali qilmaganlari haqida gaplar tuzing.
exercises.explanationUz:
⚠ AUDIO KERAK - qaysi ishlar
bajarilgani faqat yozuvdan.


SAKKIZ ISh:

  paint the walls - devorlarni
     bo'yamoq
  hang the curtains - pardalarni
     osmoq
  lay the carpets - gilamlarni
     to'shamoq
  repair the back door - orqa
     eshikni ta'mirlamoq
  buy all the furniture - hamma
     mebelni sotib olmoq
  put up shelves - javonlarni
     o'rnatmoq
  tidy the garden - bog'ni
     tartibga keltirmoq
  mend the fence - devorni (panjara)
     tuzatmoq


⚠ GAP QOLIPLARI (audiodan keyin):

  ✓ → They've already painted the
      walls.
  ✗ → They haven't hung the curtains
      yet.


⚠ 'SO FAR':

  = hozirgacha.
  ⚠ Present perfect bilan.


⚠ 'TO LAY A CARPET':

  = gilam to'shamoq.
  ⚠ lay - laid - LAID.
  ⚠ 'lie' (yotmoq) bilan
  ADAShTIRMANG.


⚠ 'TO MEND' va 'TO REPAIR':

  Ikkalasi = tuzatmoq, ta'mirlamoq.
  ⚠ 'mend' - Britaniya, oddiyroq.


⚠ 'FURNITURE':

  = mebel.
  ⚠ SANALMAYDIGAN! 'furnitures' XATO.
  ⚠ 'a piece of furniture' ✓


⚠ 'A FENCE':

  = panjara, devor (hovli atrofida).

points.en: paint the walls → They've already painted the walls. / They haven't painted the walls yet.
points.uz: devorlarni bo'yamoq → Ular allaqachon devorlarni bo'yashgan. / Ular hali devorlarni bo'yashmagan.
points.noteUz: ⚠ Audio kerak - qaysi qolip to'g'riligi yozuvdan.

⚠ put - put - PUT.
⚠ 'to put up' = o'rnatmoq (devorga).
